coverage.heading: Subjects You Can Teach & Learn on ToppScorers
coverage.subtext: From foundational school classes (1–12) and board exams to JEE, NEET, civil services, and modern tech skills — connect with verified educators across every subject that matters.
coverage.schoolLowerDesc: Build robust conceptual clarity and homework mastery in Maths, Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology), and Social Science for growing young minds.
coverage.schoolSeniorDesc: Deep-dive subject specialization across Physics, Chemistry, Maths, and Biology (PCMB) with rigorous problem solving.
coverage.schoolBoardDesc: Tailored scoring strategies, previous years question papers, and answer presentation techniques for CBSE and state boards.
coverage.schoolFoundationDesc: Early conceptual foundation courses bridging school syllabus to JEE, NEET, Olympiads, and NTSE analytical benchmarks.
coverage.jeeDesc: Comprehensive coaching in Physics, Chemistry, and Advanced Mathematics for IIT, NIT, and IIIT admissions.
coverage.neetDesc: Intensive line-by-line NCERT mastery across Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (Botany and Zoology) for top medical colleges.
coverage.otherEntranceDesc: Specialized training for BITSAT, CUET (Central Universities), and state CETs (MHT-CET, KCET, WBJEE) for premier college admissions.
coverage.upscDesc: Comprehensive GS mentorship covering History, Polity, Geography, Economics, Current Affairs, and CSAT answer writing.
coverage.gateDesc: Advanced engineering coaching for GATE, ESE, and PSU technical tests across Mechanical, Civil, Electrical, and CS streams.
coverage.sscBankingDesc: Speed shortcuts and high-accuracy training in Quantitative Aptitude, Logical Reasoning, English, and General Awareness.
coverage.teachingLawDesc: Pedagogy and concepts for CTET, State TETs, plus law entrance (CLAT), commerce, and management preparation.
coverage.skillsDesc: Hands-on coding, programming (Python, Java, C++, Web Dev), Data Science, AI basics, and digital upskilling mentorship.

verification.title: Teacher Profile Verification
verification.subtitle: Verify your identity and teaching credentials to earn trust, unlock direct student outreach, and receive a verified badge.
verification.stepContact: Contact Phone for Verification & Physical Coordination
verification.stepContactDesc: Your direct phone number. Kept strictly private and accessed only by our ToppScorers team to verify credentials and physically coordinate tuition batches between you and students.
verification.phonePrivacyBadge: 100% Private: Never visible to students or the public. ToppScorers coordinates tuitions directly as a trusted medium.
verification.stepIdentityDesc: Aadhaar Card or PAN Card to verify your authentic identity. (If not readily available, select NA).
verification.stepQualificationsDesc: Specify your highest degree (B.Tech, M.Sc, B.Ed, M.A, Ph.D, etc.) and university.
verification.highestDegree: Highest Degree (e.g. M.Sc Physics, B.Tech, B.Ed)
verification.stepCertificationsDesc: National or State eligibility tests (CTET, State TET, NET, SET, B.Ed). Select NA if not applicable.
verification.stepExperienceDesc: Tell us where you've taught and your total years of experience.
verification.instituteName: Current or Past School / Coaching Institute
verification.stepSubjectsDesc: Comma-separated subjects and target exams you coach.
verification.examsPlaceholder: e.g. JEE Main, NEET, CBSE Class 12, Foundation
verification.stepProofDesc: A short video or bio helps students immediately trust your teaching style.
verification.demoVideo: Demo Lecture Video Link (YouTube unlisted / Google Drive)
verification.bioPlaceholder: Dedicated educator on ToppScorers committed to high concept clarity and student success...
verification.stepReferencesDesc: Contact details of a colleague, principal, or mentor who can vouch for your teaching.
verification.skipNotice: You can skip verification. However, you will not be able to send tuition requests to students until verified.
verification.submittedToast: Your verification details have been submitted. Our team will review within 24–48 hours.

promptModal.title: Verify Your Teaching Profile
promptModal.subtitle: Get verified to contact students directly, unlock tuition leads, and earn your Verified badge.
promptModal.perk1: Direct Student Outreach: Contact students seeking tuition directly without restrictions.

promptModal.optionalHelp: Note: You can skip any document or mark 'NA' if you don't have it right now.

homeBar.unverifiedDesc: You can receive student requests, but you cannot initiate contact or send requests to students without verification. Verify degree & identity (or mark NA) to unlock full outreach!
homeBar.pendingDesc: Your submitted credentials are in our admin queue. You can browse and receive student requests while review is underway.
homeBar.verifiedDesc: Your profile is officially verified. You have full privileges to search and directly contact students seeking tuition.
